fields.name: id
fields.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the person: made once from the name when the row is created, and kept when the name changes. It is a key, not a spelling.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name the person is published under.

fields.name: github
fields.description: The GitHub login of the person, with the case it has on GitHub.

fields.name: source
fields.description: A public record, linked as a web address, that connects the person to the name and login.
